==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{UserTimeZone|zone=|zonename=}}</nowiki></code> to your user page, filling all relevant fields. Check [[wikipedia:List of time zones|Wikipedia's list of time zones]] to find the link to the Wikipedia article describing your timezone.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para|zone}} The user's numerical time zone relative to [[wikipedia:Greenwich Mean Time|GMT]] or [[wikipedia:Coordinated Universal Time|UTC]] standard time.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{Para|zonename}}The name of the user's time zone.</li>

==Examples==
{| class="wikitable"
! Code !! Result
|-
| <code><nowiki>{{UserTimeZone|zone=UTC+5:45|zonename=Nepal Time}}</nowiki></code> || {{UserTimeZone|zone=UTC+5:45|zonename=Nepal Time}}
|}
